<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Consulta de Disponibilidade">eff4514b83e7cf503d22a8d0deaad358</macroponent><name>set Participants Count</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {

    const participantes = event.payload.value || '';

    console.log('===== PARTICIPANTES =====');
    console.log('Participantes:', participantes);

    api.setState('participants_count', participantes);

    const filters = [];

    if (api.state.select_building) {
        filters.push('predio=' + api.state.select_building);
    }

    if (api.state.select_floor) {
        filters.push('andar=' + api.state.select_floor);
    }

    filters.push('ativo_para_reserva=true');

    if (participantes && !isNaN(Number(participantes))) {
        filters.push('capacidade>=' + Number(participantes));
    }

    const roomFilter = filters.join('^');

    const salasIndisponiveis = api.state.unavailable_rooms || [];

    if (salasIndisponiveis.length > 0) {
        roomFilter += '^sys_idNOT IN' + salasIndisponiveis.join(',');
    }
    console.log('ROOM FILTER:', roomFilter);
    api.setState('room_filter', roomFilter);
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-01 22:55:28</sys_created_on><sys_id>c633eeeb83e307903d22a8d0deaad3eb</sys_id><sys_mod_count>7</sys_mod_count><sys_name>set Participants Count</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Gestao de Espacos" source="x_1026684_gestao_0">c869e29a83638b503d22a8d0deaad38c</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Gestao de Espacos">c869e29a83638b503d22a8d0deaad38c</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_c633eeeb83e307903d22a8d0deaad3eb</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-07 00:03:05</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>
